correctness.rationale: The Weyl integration formula for type C2 with four positive roots and Weyl-group order 8 gives exact moments mu_{n,k} via finite Laurent constant terms. A separately run standard-library checker reproduces every moment table entry for n=2,4,6,8; the central involution proves odd-k cancellations. All remaining mixed even-k moments are strictly positive, forcing optimal complex coefficient relative phase 0 or pi. Both real-magnitude polynomials follow by binomial expansion. H6 derivative is -3(16p²+60p-35) with its unique interior root; H8 derivative is 28(157p³-240p²-40p+60), whose bracket cubic has strictly negative derivative on [0,1]. Exact signs at p=1/2 prove the reversal. Numerical quadrature only corroborates these analytic facts.

value.rationale: The two fundamental characters are canonical centered/variance-one genus-two Sato–Tate coefficient statistics. Their sharp variance-normalized higher moments quantify maximal high-moment amplification of an arbitrary complex linear contrast, a natural invariant for Fourier interpolation and moment-based tail estimates. The rigorous order-6 to order-8 reversal of which irreducible channel carries more extremal variance is qualitative and cannot be inferred from individual/marginal moments or a single sixth-order optimization; the theorem provides both exact algebraic constants and all extremizers without asserting an unproved arithmetic application.
